note: Core transactional tables. Every tenant table also has standard columns (tenant_id, id, row_version, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by; logs omit update columns). Column flags: pk, notNull, unique. references: target table; crossSchema=true means no FK (checked by the owning service). The authoritative DDL is db/migrations/V0001__core_schema.sql.
